name: my-day
title: My Day
description: Today's calendar agenda, your Apple Reminders and Markdown work checklists in one keyboard-first place. Local only, works on Raycast Free.
author: bret

commands.name: my-day
commands.title: My Day
commands.description: Your day: what has to happen, the main task, supporting tasks and tomorrow. Pick tasks from checklists and undated reminders, complete, push to tomorrow. Give this command your hotkey or alias.

commands.name: checklists
commands.title: Checklists
commands.description: Saved work checklists: nested checkbox items with notes, stored as Markdown files you control.

commands.name: my-day-setup
commands.title: My Day Setup
commands.description: Check Calendar and Reminders access, choose the checklist folder, and see how to assign a hotkey.

preferences.name: checklistFolder
preferences.title: Checklist folder
preferences.description: Where checklist Markdown files live. Leave empty for ~/Library/Application Support/My Day/Checklists. You may point it inside an Obsidian vault; My Day never reads other notes there, only .md files in this folder.

preferences.name: editorApp
preferences.title: Editor for Open in Editor
preferences.description: App used by Open in Editor (⌘⇧O). Leave empty to use the default app for .md files.

preferences.name: timeFormat
preferences.title: Time format
preferences.description: How times are shown and offered in pickers. System follows System Settings → General → Date & Time.

preferences.name: dayStart
preferences.title: Working day starts
preferences.description: Free time is offered from this hour.

preferences.name: dayEnd
preferences.title: Working day ends
preferences.description: Free time is offered until this hour.

scripts.build:helper: mkdir -p assets && swiftc -O -swift-version 5 -target arm64-apple-macos14 helper/*.swift -o assets/myday-helper && (cd helper && shasum -a 256 *.swift > SOURCES.sha256)
scripts.lint: eslint src test && prettier --check src test
scripts.fix-lint: eslint src test --fix && prettier --write src test
